TransformOptions: Options for specifying a transform origin point. Use `anchor` for a local bounding-box relative point, or `pivot` for an absolute world coordinate. Only one of the two should be specified; if both are set, `pivot` takes precedence.

TransformOption: Accepts either a bare Vec3 (shorthand for `{ anchor: vec }`) or explicit `TransformOptions`. - `rotate(angle, DL)` → treated as `{ anchor: DL }` - `rotate(angle, { anchor: [0, 0.5, 0] })` → continuous local anchor - `rotate(angle, { pivot: [20, 20, 0] })` → absolute world coordinate
